newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr slightly down on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr slightly down on dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr fell slightly against the dollar on Monday, after spending two weeks unchanged, the central National Bank said.
A rate of 6.35 per dollar will apply to all transactions outside currency auctions for the week September 9 to 15, the bank said.
The birr was unchanged at 6.34 against the dollar, following foreign currency auctions during the last two weeks.
About $15 million was made available at the weekly currency auction under the supervision of the central bank on Saturday.
